Each dumpling probably weighs about 25-30 g, so 6 come to roughly 165 g. The chili oil and sauce add a little more, for a total of about 175 g.

Dumplings run about 1.7 kcal/g, which gives roughly 300 kcal. The chili oil adds some more, so I estimate about 320 kcal.
